title: AWS re:Invent 2025: How to watch and follow along live
description: Amazon Web Services’ big annual event, re:Invent 2025, is getting into full swing in Las Vegas this week, and you can follow the keynotes live right here.
author: Morgan Little

title: AWS announces new capabilities for its AI agent builder
description: AWS is introducing new capabilities for its AI agent-building platform, including memory and evaluation tools.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Amazon releases an impressive new AI chip and teases an Nvidia-friendly roadmap
description: AWS has been building its own AI chips — and systems — for years now. It just released its third version, known as Trainium3, with some impressive specs.
author: Julie Bort

title: Simular’s AI agent wants to run your Mac, Windows PC for you
description: Simular, a startup building AI agents for Mac OS and Windows, has solved the AI hallucination problem in a compelling way.
author: Julie Bort

title: Mistral closes in on Big AI rivals with new open-weight frontier and small models
description: Mistral unveils its Mistral 3 lineup, including a frontier model and efficient small models designed for offline, customizable enterprise use — aiming to prove small, fine-tuned AI can beat closed-source giants.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Paris-based AI voice startup Gradium nabs $70M seed
description: Gradium, a startup spawned out of French AI lab Kyutai (backed by French telecom billionaire Xavier Niel), launched out of stealth on Tuesday.
author: Julie Bort

title: What does it mean when Uncle Sam is one of your biggest shareholders? Chip startup xLight is about to find out
description: You can imagine how this is all going over in Silicon Valley, where the libertarian ethos runs deep.
author: Connie Loizos

title: Apple just named a new AI chief with Google and Microsoft expertise, as John Giannandrea steps down
description: His replacement is Amar Subramanya, a highly regarded Microsoft executive who spent 16 years at Google, most recently leading engineering for the Gemini Assistant. It's a savvy hire, given that Subramanya knows the competition intimately.
author: Connie Loizos

title: One of Google’s biggest AI advantages is what it already knows about you
description: The promise is AI that's uniquely helpful because it knows you. But the risk is AI that feels more like surveillance than service.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Nvidia announces new open AI models and tools for autonomous driving research
description: Nvidia continues its push into physical AI with the release of a new reasoning world model and other tools for physical AI.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Construction workers are cashing in on the AI boom
description: "I pinch myself going to work every day," one 51-year-old says of his new supervisor role overseeing 200 workers at a data center site.
author: Connie Loizos

title: Data center energy demand forecasted to soar nearly 300% through 2035
description: New planned data centers promise to consume even more energy than expected. Meanwhile, a grid monitor is blaming such growth for high electricity prices.
author: Tim De Chant

title: OpenAI’s investment into Thrive Holdings is its latest circular deal
description: Analysts will be watching to see if Thrive-owned firms actually succeed in building long-term profitable businesses using OpenAI’s tech, or if the result is really just pumped up valuations based on speculative market potential.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Nvidia’s $2B Synopsys bet tightens its grip on the chip-design stack
description: The $2 billion investment in Synopsys, which makes software and components for designing semiconductor chips, deepens their existing partnership at a time when analysts scrutinize circular AI-industry deals and warn of a potential bubble.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Amazon’s AI chatbot Rufus drove sales on Black Friday
description: On Black Friday, Amazon sessions that resulted in a sale were up 100% in the U.S. when the AI chatbot Rufus was used. They only increased by 20% when Rufus wasn't used.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Black Forest Labs raises $300M at $3.25B valuation
description: The round was co-led by Salesforce Ventures and Anjney Midha (AMP), and saw participation from a16z, NVIDIA, Northzone, Creandum, Earlybird VC, BroadLight Capital, General Catalyst, Temasek, Bain Capital Ventures, Air Street Capital, Visionaries Club, Canva and Figma Ventures.
author: Ram Iyer

title: ‘Avatar’ director James Cameron says generative AI is ‘horrifying’
description: James Cameron’s movies are often at the cutting edge of visual effects technology, but that doesn't make him a fan of generative AI.
author: Anthony Ha

title: New report examines how David Sacks might profit from Trump administration role
description: David Sacks’ role as President Donald Trump’s artificial intelligence and crypto czar could work out very well for his investments, according to a new report. However, Sacks fired back, calling the story a "nothing burger."
author: Anthony Ha

title: ChatGPT launched three years ago today
description: It’s no hyperbole to suggest that ChatGPT subsequently transformed the worlds of business and tech.
author: Anthony Ha

title: Black Friday sets online spending record of $11.8B, Adobe says
description: American consumers spent $11.8 billion online on Black Friday, according to data from Adobe Analytics, which says it tracks more than 1 trillion visits to U.S. retail websites.
author: Anthony Ha

title: No, you can’t get your AI to ‘admit’ to being sexist, but it probably is
description: Though LLMs might not use explicitly biased language, they may infer your demographic data and display implicit biases, researchers say.
author: Dominic-Madori Davis

title: Supabase hit $5B by turning down million-dollar contracts. Here’s why.
description: Vibe coding has taken the tech industry by storm, and it’s not just the Lovables and Replits of the world that are winning. The startups building the infrastructure behind them are cashing in too.  Supabase, the open-source database platform that’s become the backend of choice for the vibe-coding world, raised $100 million at a $5 billion valuation just months after closing $200 million at $2 billion.
